name: Lobster Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy arborio risotto with diced lobster mushrooms, shallot, celery and sherry, finished with Parmesan and herbs.

ingredients.item: chicken or seafood stock, kept warm

steps.title: Warm the stock
steps.text: Heat the stock in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer, not a boil, while you cook the rice.

steps.title: Sauté the base
steps.text: Melt the butter in a wide, heavy pot over medium-high heat. Cook the shallot, celery, garlic and mushrooms until the shallot turns translucent.

steps.title: Add the sherry and rice
steps.text: Pour in the sherry and cook until most of the alcohol has evaporated. Stir in the rice to coat it in the butter and cook for a couple of minutes.

steps.title: Add the stock
steps.text: Add the warm stock one ladleful at a time, stirring and letting each addition absorb before the next, until the rice is tender but still al dente and the risotto is creamy, not soupy.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Take the pot off the heat and stir in the Parmesan. Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with the parsley or chives.

notes: The original recipe also adds cooked lobster meat at the end; the mushrooms are good on their own.
Dry white wine or dry vermouth can stand in for the sherry.
This makes a large pot. Halve everything for a smaller batch.
